nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Index and status tracker for the 2026-06-11 orgii dead-code and duplicate-implementation audit, covering src/ (frontend) and src-tauri/ (backend); lists the top-5 highest-ROI findings, phase-by-phase cleanup execution status, and links to the other findings documents in this directory.

nodes.name: backend-findings.md
nodes.summary: Detailed backend (Rust/Tauri) audit findings covering Tauri command registration, cross-module struct/enum name collisions (ProviderConfig, ConflictResolution), IntegrationsConfig domain-crossing, misuse of ResolvedAgent::resolve(), zombie types, deprecated items, and backward-compat shims.

nodes.name: cross-layer-findings.md
nodes.summary: Audit findings for duplication spanning both frontend and backend layers, including AgentExecMode string duplication, ~915 hardcoded Tauri command strings, scattered mode/tab-key/model string literals, and inconsistent Local/Remote naming in the sync module.

nodes.name: frontend-findings.md
nodes.summary: Detailed frontend (TypeScript/React) audit findings covering dead modules, unused default exports in services, ChatPanel engine misplacement, duplicate send-path logic (dispatchMessageBySessionType), and multi-source-of-truth atoms like holdSessionQueueForStopAtom and userInitiatedCancelAtom.
